preconditions.description: The first line of input is an integer n, where 1 ≤ n ≤ 500, representing the number of files.
The second line contains exactly n distinct file names, each a string of 1 to 8 lowercase letters.

preconditions.expression: all('import' in line for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
preconditions.description: Each of the n sections starts with a file name followed by an integer k, then k lines starting with 'import'.

preconditions.expression: all(',' in line or 'import' == line.split()[0] for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:])
preconditions.description: Each 'import' line is either a single file name or comma-space separated list of file names, with no duplicates per line.

preconditions.expression: all(file in stdin.splitlines()[1].split() for file in set().union(*[line.split()[1:].split(', ') for line in stdin.splitlines()[2:] if 'import' in line]))
preconditions.description: All imported files are listed in the second line of input.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == 'SHIP IT' if not any(cycle_exists(files, dependencies) for cycle in find_cycles(files, dependencies)) else any(all(files[dependencies[files.index(cycle[i])].index(cycle[(i+1) % len(cycle)])] == cycle[(i+1) % len(cycle)] for i in range(len(cycle))) for cycle in find_cycles(files, dependencies))
postconditions.description: If no dependency cycle exists, output 'SHIP IT'. Otherwise, output a shortest cycle as a space-separated list of file names in order, where each file imports the next, and the last imports the first.

postconditions.expression: len(cycle) <= len(c) for c in find_cycles(files, dependencies) if stdout.strip() == ' '.join(cycle)
postconditions.description: If a cycle is output, it must be a shortest cycle (minimal length).
